name: Better Hotjar Integrator
author: zainabhinav194

sections.description:
A wordpress plugin to automatically integrate your hotjar code with your wordpress website.

The Hotjar Integrator plugin makes it easy to integrate Hotjar’s powerful analytics and behavioral tracking tools into your WordPress site. This plugin makes it easy for you to add Hotjar tracking scripts to your website. without having to manually edit theme files or manage scripts.

Feature
– Easily Integrated: Configure your Hotjar site ID to enable fast tracking.
– Customizable settings: Turn script on or off and specify advanced monitoring options as desired.
– Safe Usage: The plugin adheres to WordPress coding standards and has robust escaping and sanitization to ensure secure integration.
– Lightweight and fast: Minimal impact on website performance with asynchronous script loading.
– User-friendly interface: Seamless layout through the WordPress admin panel.

Benefit:
– Get actionable insights into user behavior through heat maps. Session recording and surveys
– Improve website functionality and user experience based on real-time analytics.
– Easily test and track changes to optimize conversion rates and engagement.
– Whether you are a developer, marketer, or site owner, the Hotjar Integrator plugin is the perfect tool to easily leverage the power of Hotjar on your WordPress site.
sections.installation:
This section describes how to install the plugin and get it working.

e.g.

  1. Upload better-hotjar-integrator.php to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Better Hotjar Integrator menu in admin side bar.
  4. Enter your hotjar site id.
